statement: A published legal-RAG system already uses temporal validity as an active pre-retrieval control layer, filtering legal sources by jurisdiction, topic, lifecycle status and temporal validity, with post-generation validation that answers cite valid legal sources. This partially occupies both the validity-aware and plug-in/control-layer aspects of the proposal (abstract-level evidence only; publisher full text was not accessible).

evidence.quote: the ontology filters legal sources by jurisdiction, topic, lifecycle status, and temporal validity
